metadata.question: Was there more sediment in the Mekong River, specifically at location (20.248364, 100.141422), in January 27, 2015 compared to January 25, 2020?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Location: Mekong River at (20.248364, 100.141422) - This is in Southeast Asia, likely Thailand/Laos area - Dates: January 27, 2015 vs January 25, 2020 - Collection: Sentinel-2 (good for water sediment detection) or Landsat 8. Sentinel-2 has higher resolution. - Sediment proxy: Use spectral indices like TSS (Total Suspended Sediment) or NDTI (Normalized Difference Turbidity Index) - NDTI = (Red - SWIR) / (Red + SWIR), higher values indicate more turbidity/sediment 2. Masking strategy: - Cloud mask is necessary to avoid cloudy pixels which affect sediment measurements - Use QA60 (Sentinel-2) for cloud masking - Focus on water pixels only (NDWI > 0.3 or similar) 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero vs. Null: - Check collection size first (C1 if no images) - Check valid pixel count after cloud masking (C2 if 0 pixels) - Calculate NDTI for both dates and compare - If result is NaN or None, output C3 - If 2015 NDTI > 2020 NDTI, answer A; otherwise B ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // Define location: Mekong River at (20.248364, 100.141422) const point = ee.Geometry.Point([100.141422, 20.248364]); const buffer = point.buffer(500); // 500m buffer for analysis // Define date ranges (±3 days to capture available imagery) const date1_start = '2015-01-24'; const date1_end = '2015-01-30'; const date2_start = '2020-01-22'; const date2_end = '2020-01-28'; // Function to calculate NDTI (Normalized Difference Turbidity Index) function calculateNDTI(img) { const ndti = img.normalizedDifference(['B4', 'B11']).rename('NDTI'); return img.addBands(ndti); } // Function to mask clouds using QA60 function maskClouds(img) { const qa = img.select('QA60'); const cloudBitMask = 1 << 10; const cirrusBitMask = 1 << 11; const mask = qa.bitwiseAnd(cloudBitMask).eq(0).and(qa.bitwiseAnd(cirrusBitMask).eq(0)); return img.updateMask(mask); } // Acquire Sentinel-2 data for 2015 let col2015 = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2') .filterBounds(buffer) .filterDate(date1_start, date1_end) .map(maskClouds) .map(calculateNDTI); const size2015 = col2015.size().getInfo(); console.log(`2015 Images: ${size2015}`); if (size2015 === 0) { console.log('No images found for 2015, trying Landsat 8'); col2015 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2') .filterBounds(buffer) .filterDate(date1_start, date1_end) .select(['SR_B4', 'SR_B6']) .filterMetadata('CLOUD_COVER', 'less_than', 50); const sizeL82015 = col2015.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Landsat 8 2015: ${sizeL82015}`); if (sizeL82015 === 0) { console.log('No valid data for 2015'); console.log('C1'); return; } } // Acquire Sentinel-2 data for 2020 let col2020 = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2') .filterBounds(buffer) .filterDate(date2_start, date2_end) .map(maskClouds) .map(calculateNDTI); const size2020 = col2020.size().getInfo(); console.log(`2020 Images: ${size2020}`); if (size2020 === 0) { console.log('No images found for 2020, trying Landsat 8'); col2020 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2') .filterBounds(buffer) .filterDate(date2_start, date2_end) .select(['SR_B4', 'SR_B6']) .filterMetadata('CLOUD_COVER', 'less_than', 50); const sizeL82020 = col2020.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Landsat 8 2020: ${sizeL82020}`); if (sizeL82020 === 0) { console.log('No valid data for 2020'); console.log('C1'); return; } } // Calculate median NDTI for 2015 const median2015 = col2015.select('NDTI').median(); const count2015 = median2015.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: buffer, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('NDTI').getInfo(); console.log(`2015 Valid pixels: ${count2015}`); if (count2015 === 0) { console.log('No valid pixels for 2015 after masking'); console.log('C2'); return; } const ndti2015 = median2015.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: buffer, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('NDTI').getInfo(); // Calculate median NDTI for 2020 const median2020 = col2020.select('NDTI').median(); const count2020 = median2020.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: buffer, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('NDTI').getInfo(); console.log(`2020 Valid pixels: ${count2020}`); if (count2020 === 0) { console.log('No valid pixels for 2020 after masking'); console.log('C2'); return; } const ndti2020 = median2020.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: buffer, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('NDTI').getInfo(); console.log(`NDTI 2015: ${ndti2015}`); console.log(`NDTI 2020: ${ndti2020}`); // Validation if (ndti2015 === null || isNaN(ndti2015) || ndti2020 === null || isNaN(ndti2020)) { console.log('Calculation resulted in invalid values'); console.log('C3'); return; } // Compare if (ndti2015 > ndti2020) { console.log('More sediment in 2015 than 2020'); console.log('A'); } else { console.log('More sediment in 2020 than 2015 or equal'); console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
